text: Riocan Holdings Inc. ("RioCan") applied for Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendments and Plan of Subdivision to permit the redevelopment of their lands at 815-­845 Eglinton Avenue East (the "Applications"). The Applications were appealed to the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal ("LPAT", now Ontario Land Tribunal, "OLT" or "Tribunal") citing Council's failure to make a decision within the time allotted by the Planning Act. The Parties to the appeals participated in a private mediation session on November 18-20, 2019. In November, 2019, RioCan made a settlement offer to the City to resolve the appeals, which was accepted by City Council at its meeting of November 26 and 27, 2019 (the "Settlement Offer").
